title: Army Research Laboratory finds lifter thrust exceeds ion flow

tellings.quote: uh arl said it was like at least 10 20% above what could be achieved by ion flow

plain: In the 2000s the Army Research Laboratory, the US Army's main science lab, tested "lifters", light devices that rise when high voltage is run through them, and found that they pushed at least 10 to 20 percent harder than the electrically charged air flowing off them, called ion flow, could explain. Gary McKinnon, a British hacker who says he found evidence of a secret NASA space programme, tells this to Jesse Michels, citing the lab and a group called Blaze Labs. If true, it would hint that some other force is lifting the devices.
